name: The Internet Evolution: Dropper
desc:
❤️ Please Give A Like If You Enjoy The Game ❤️

Welcome to The Internet Evolution: Dropper.
Fall through the history of the internet while dodging memes, nostalgia, chaos, and iconic eras from 1990s to 2020s.

🎯 Goal:
Reach the bottom of each drop without dying. Survive the memes. Beat the challenge. Rebirth to flex your progress.

💡 Every level gets harder as you advance.
New eras and meme stages are always being added.
All levels are possible.

🚀 Features

✔️ 20+ eras of internet history
✔️ Meme nostalgia from old to new
✔️ Leaderboards and private servers
This game contains mild flashing colors and fast movement.

🔔 UPDATE 01/10/2026

⭐ Two New Levels OUT
🎯 Admin Abilities ADDED!
🌍 Added Expert World

*More updates coming soon*

If you find any bugs or have suggestions, post them on our group wall so they can be fixed.
👉 Created by: https://www.roblox.com/communities/247343938/Djebug-Studios

Have fun dropping and good luck reaching 2026 🏆
